name: Jess Ranch Marketplace
summary: Jess Ranch Marketplace is a 500,000+ square foot open-air shopping center in Apple Valley, California, featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment options including Cinemark Theatres. Located in the heart of San Bernardino County, it serves as the premier shopping destination for the High Desert community.
demographics: Jess Ranch Marketplace serves the Apple Valley community in San Bernardino County, attracting primarily middle-income families and households from the High Desert region. The trade area draws visitors from surrounding communities seeking convenient access to everyday shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The center appeals to a broad demographic mix including young families, working professionals, and retirees who value the open-air shopping experience and diverse tenant offerings including grocery, dining, and cinema entertainment.
description: Jess Ranch Marketplace is a premier shopping destination located in the heart of Apple Valley, California, in San Bernardino County. Spanning over 500,000 square feet, this expansive open-air shopping center offers visitors a comprehensive retail and entertainment experience with a diverse mix of stores, restaurants, and attractions. The center features Cinemark Theatres as a major entertainment anchor, providing moviegoers with the latest film releases and modern cinema amenities. With its convenient location along Bear Valley Road, Jess Ranch Marketplace serves as a central gathering place for the High Desert community, offering everything from everyday shopping needs to dining and entertainment options. The center's open-air design creates an inviting atmosphere where visitors can enjoy Southern California's pleasant weather while exploring the variety of retail stores and culinary options available throughout the property.
